thought.text: The bullseye PGDG repo is gone. Let me check for archive/snapshot alternatives.

reasoning_content:
The Debian-based postgis images (17-3.5, 16-3.5) use bullseye and the pgdg bullseye repo is gone. The Alpine-based ones don't use apt. The db Dockerfile installs postgresql-17-pgrouting from apt.

Options:
1. Change base image to a Debian image with a working pgdg repo. But 17-3.5 is bullseye only. There is no bookworm variant of postgis 17.
2. Use the alpine variant and install pgrouting via apk. But the Dockerfile uses apt-get.
3. Work around by pointing the bullseye-pgdg repo to a snapshot. pgdg has bullseye-pgdg-snapshot? Let me check. The dists listing didn't have bullseye-pgdg-snapshot. Hmm. It has bookworm-pgdg-snapshot but not bullseye. So bullseye is fully gone from pgdg.

Wait - let me check the archive. Actually pgdg has an archive at https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/archive/ maybe. Let me check.

Actually, the important thing: do we even need pgrouting? The init.sh creates extension pgrouting. If pgrouting isn't installed, DB init would fail. But maybe pgrouting can be installed via a different method.

Alternative: modify the db Dockerfile to use a different approach. But the guide is the primary source. The task says I may perform actions reasonably necessary. Since db build fails due to upstream repo removal, I can work around it.

Let me check the pgdg archive for bullseye.

Actually, there's a simpler workaround: install pgrouting from the postgis image's existing packages? Not present.

Another option: use `postgis/postgis:17-3.5-alpine` and install pgrouting using apk. Let me check if pgrouting is available in alpine repos. postgresql17-pgrouting exists in alpine? Alpine's main repos have postgresql-pgrouting maybe.

Let me first check pgdg archive availability.

action.command: echo "=== pgdg archive ==="; curl -s http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/archive/dists/ | grep -o 'href="[^"]*bullseye[^"]*"' | head; echo "=== try archive bullseye Release ==="; curl -sSI "http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/archive/dists/bullseye-pgdg/Release" | head -3; echo "=== snapshot ==="; curl -sSI "http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/dists/bullseye-pgdg-snapshot/Release" | head -3
